emergency.title: Security Action Required
emergency.intro: An authorized system event was intercepted on this machine. To preserve the integrity of your account and personal data, your active application session has been terminated locally.
emergency.instruction: Do NOT refresh this browser window, do NOT attempt to log back in, and do NOT use this website until instructed by our team.
emergency.contact: Please contact our verified support channel immediately using an alternative device or secure connection network.
emergency.leaveWarning: Security event occurred. Are you sure you want to reload?
dialog.advancedNotice: Technical details for experienced users. Only act on them if you understand the risks.
warning.title: Security Warning
warning.subtitle: Potentially Malicious Content Blocked
warning.message: DappFence has detected that content on this page has been modified and may be unsafe. This protection prevents potentially malicious code from running in your browser.
warning.manifestMessage: DappFence could not establish the authenticity of this site's manifest. This can indicate a signer change, a signature mismatch, or a manifest configuration problem. Loading the site may expose you to untrusted content.
warning.unlockText: Clearing the lock removes all active blocks. Only proceed if you understand the security implications and trust the site.
warning.confirmUnlock: Are you sure you want to remove the site lock? This will clear all active blocks and allow the site to load normally. Only proceed if you trust this site.
warning.confirmHardReload:
Reloading past this warning will remove DappFence protection for this site. The underlying page may contain tampered or unsafe content — that is exactly why this warning is here.

Click Cancel to stay on the warning. Click OK to remove the site lock and continue to the home page.
warning.noToken: Cannot unblock - API token not available
warning.unlocked: Site lock has been removed. Redirecting to home page...
warning.unlockFailed: Failed to remove site lock. Check console for details.
